## OS3-01 injury feedback — required root contract

Consume the exact transient `threat-damage` event in M2-A-CONTRACT. Use event target/actual loss, not health-delta inference. Keep bite and collision accumulation separate in the existing impact-chip area. Same-target bites form one unsaved episode expiring 3 active seconds after its last bite; accumulate raw loss, round only display. Flash at onset, then at most once per active second. Suppress calm hints during aftermath without extending actual pursuit.

Observe each fixed-step actor/state transition before accepting that step's damage; multiple steps in a frame accumulate once per step. A bitten hull remains the target if disabled while still controlled. Same-step diver incapacity, recovery or actor replacement clears invalid feedback. Reset on pause/panel/menu/refuge/recovery/new/import/Continue/graphics loss/reconstruction/disposal. Inspect actual availability callback paths; reconstruction does not necessarily call entered(). No state or save field.

Give one accessible onset per episode with no 60 Hz live-region churn. Same-step disable/recovery speech takes priority; retain the truthful disabled-hull chip without competing assertive onset. Cancel pending work on every reset/context change. Preserve accepted ordered full exit-refusal announcements, persistent errors, action/hazard ownership and call bearings. One centred onset sound is allowed only while valid and when that batch lacks another damage/recovery cue; preserve current spatial calls and mute/captions behavior. Document precise speech/audio arbitration before handoff.

Cover single positive bite, zero loss, 40 steps (2/3 s, not 2 s), a separate >=121-step sustained cadence, simultaneous collision, disable/incapacity, target switch, multiple steps/frame, interruption/reconstruction and mute/captions-off. Native mutation traces prove DOM delivery, not human screen-reader speech or audible mix.
